scripts.test:e2e:sync: if test -n "${PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL:-}" && test "${INKSTONE_LIVE_E2E:-}" = 1 && test "${INKSTONE_LIVE_E2E_DESTRUCTIVE_ACK:-}" = DELETE_TEST_DATA; then playwright test tests/e2e/live-sync.spec.js --project=chromium-desktop; else printf '%s\n' 'Refusing destructive live E2E: set PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL, INKSTONE_LIVE_E2E=1, and INKSTONE_LIVE_E2E_DESTRUCTIVE_ACK=DELETE_TEST_DATA' >&2; exit 1; fi
